plan: This ascending clock auction with sealed exit bids functions as a second-price auction: I win if my bid is highest, and I pay the second-highest bid, not my own. Therefore, bidding my true value ($25) is the dominant strategy—it maximizes expected profit since I only pay less than my bid when I win, and bidding higher or lower than true value only risks either overpaying or losing profitable opportunities.
